required_evidence: E3_HOLDOUT_CONFIRMED by default for promotion to mandatory architecture

decision_table.C1_full_trajectory_worse: retain as negative evidence; do not transfer full trajectory by default

promotion_requirements: paired controlled evidence with frozen workspace/checkpoint/successor where feasible
independent verification of final task success
total-system accounting including handoff and recovery costs
effect survives a separate unseen holdout
simpler workspace-only and existing-compression baselines lose materially within the supported scope
no existing provider supplies equivalent benefit at lower integration and maintenance cost
stop_conditions: workspace-only is economically equivalent or superior
existing compression is economically equivalent or superior
continuity gains disappear after payload/bootstrap/verification cost
state transfer increases false confidence or state-induced errors enough to eliminate net benefit
architecture_if_supported: Only the smallest empirically sufficient continuity capability is eligible. Task Runtime, vector memory, learned memory, or adaptive Context Compiler are not implied.
architecture_if_refuted: Do not add custom Task State solely for handoff; preserve workspace-only or reuse existing context facilities.
